properties.site-address: West End Service Station, North Seaton Road, Newbiggin-by-the-Sea
properties.notes: Existing garage site offering potential opportunity for infill development. Currently in use by car sales business and therefore not available in the short-term. Permission was approved for demolition of petrol station and redevelopment of site for 12 apartments, but this lapsed due to non-commencement (10/S/00536/VARYCO). This permission extended an original outline application (06/00393/OUT).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
